description: Our two level loft can sleep 6 in 4 bedrooms.In the upper level, one large dinning room opens to the living room with a fire place leading to a large kitchen openning to 3 bedrooms. In the lower level one very large library room with a piano, WIFI, Cable TV an one bedroomThe spaceStunning duplex located on floors of a historic landmark building built in 1780, overlooking a quiet and luminous courtyard.Very sunny and quiet Located in central Paris's 2nd arrondissement, in the Sentier/Montorgueil neighborhood (1 minutes away from the Sentier metro station). Despite its location in central, bustling Paris, the Loft duplex is surprisingly quiet.There are 2 Velib bike stations (Velib is Paris's amazing bike sharing service) right next door. There is also several supermarket, organic food stores, a Kayser and Le Pain Quotidien bakerys, pastry shops and cafes, and a farmer's market twice a week, all in the neighbourhood.The duplex is accessible with a private elevator.Other things to noteFrom the bed/sleeping perspective the flat has:- One double bed bedroom, (upper level)- One single bed bedroom (upper level)- One bedroom with one single bed + one double bed (upper level)- One double bed room, (lower lovel)
